create_multihead_attention: create a MultiHeadAttention module with specified num_heads, key_size, and weight initializer
build_attention_output: build an AttentionOutput dataclass containing out embeddings and attention logits
run_multihead_attention: run MultiHeadAttention with query, key, value tensors and optional mask to compute attention
test_attention_masking: test MultiHeadAttention with a boolean mask to block attention over padded or invalid positions
review_linear_projection: review the _linear_projection method that projects inputs into per-head key, query, and value vectors
